items.title: Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones
items.description: A flaw in Git can let a malicious repository run an attacker's code on a computer that clones it recursively, together with its submodules. The Git project fixed it this week in Git 2.56.1, with matching fixes for the 2.50 through 2.55 series in 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1 and 2.55.1. items.description: Notion has confirmed that a security incident at Fireworks AI exposed Notion AI chat transcripts linked to fewer than 1% of its customer workspaces. Insights, a feature that helps teams understand their AI usage, used the affected conversations. Notion said its own systems were not breached and no other Notion features were affected.
